title: UGC Commerce Video Prompt Schema
description: Schema for structured AI video prompt conversion output in a short-form ecommerce workflow.

task_type.description: Fixed task type for this schema.

summary.description: Top-level summary of the prompt objective and generation intent.

prompt_objective.description: Primary generation goal of the prompt.

target_platform.description: Target use platform such as TikTok, Reels, Shorts, or ecommerce ads.

target_model.description: AI video model target if specified.

video_style.description: Desired output style such as UGC, demo-led, premium, comparison, testimonial, or showcase.

main_promise.description: Primary product promise the generated video should communicate.

orientation.description: Target orientation or aspect ratio intent.

source_interpretation.description: Interpretation of the source material being converted into a prompt.

core_scene_logic.description: Summary of the visual or persuasion flow extracted from the input.

proof_requirement.description: What must be visibly shown to support the product claim.

creator_presence.description: Whether the concept depends on a visible person or creator.

cta_goal.description: What action or viewer outcome the prompt should support.

visual_strategy.description: High-level visual plan before the final prompt is written.

structure_type.description: Visual sequence logic such as hook-demo-proof-cta, result-first, comparison, or testimonial flow.

opening_strategy.description: How the prompt should visually open to establish attention or clarity.

product_role.description: How the product should function visually in the sequence.

proof_strategy.description: How the product claim should be made believable on screen.

ending_strategy.description: How the final beat should visually resolve and support action.

product_definition.description: Product identity guidance for stable generation.

product_description.description: Visual description of the hero product.

shape_and_form_note.description: Key product shape or silhouette constraints.

packaging_note.description: Packaging visibility or fidelity guidance if relevant.

product_consistency_requirements.description: Rules for keeping the product stable across shots.

subject_definition.description: Human subject or creator behavior guidance if applicable.

subject_role.description: General role such as creator, customer, demonstrator, or narrator.

appearance_note.description: Broad appearance or styling note if needed.

behavior_note.description: How the person should behave on camera.

interaction_note.description: How the subject should interact with the product.

environment_purpose.description: Why this setting helps the product or message.

background_control_note.description: How clean, minimal, or detailed the environment should be.

scene_sequence.description: Ordered visual beat plan that the final prompt should encode.

product_visibility_note.description: How clearly the product appears in this scene.

camera_and_motion_plan.description: General camera language for the prompt.

framing_style.description: General framing approach such as close-up heavy, creator-facing, mixed, or product-led.

motion_style.description: General motion style such as handheld, smooth, static, or mixed.

pace_note.description: How quickly the sequence should unfold.

clarity_priority_note.description: How camera behavior should support product readability.

style_and_quality_constraints.description: Visual style and quality expectations for the generated result.

style_keywords.description: Useful style descriptors for the final prompt.

avoid_visual_tone.description: Visual tones or treatments to avoid.

negative_constraints.description: Prompt-level negative constraints to reduce likely generation errors.

prompt_format.description: Prompt packaging style such as paragraph, scene_block, or hybrid.

compressed_prompt.description: Optional shorter version of the prompt for compact workflows.

model_adaptation_note.description: How this prompt was adapted for the named or assumed model.

variant_prompts.description: Optional alternate prompt directions for testing or style adjustments.

variant_focus.description: What changes in this variant, such as stronger hook, softer UGC tone, or cleaner product showcase.

use_case_note.description: When this variant is most useful.

execution_notes.description: Guidance for practical downstream use of the prompt.

rerun_guidance.description: What to strengthen or simplify if the first generation fails.

most_critical_elements.description: Elements that must be preserved in any rerun or rewrite.

likely_failure_modes.description: Common risks such as product drift, unclear action, or overly cinematic output.

handoff_note.description: How this prompt should be used next in the workflow.

assumptions.description: Assumptions made because the source material or constraints were incomplete.

warnings.description: Important limitations, proof risks, or generation concerns.

next_steps.description: Suggested follow-up actions after prompt creation.
